finding_dispositions.note: The canonical authority topology now places exact Engineering technical authorization, depth evaluation, prerequisite closure and custody upstream of Core1/Core2 semantic and assessment reconstruction.
Both normative documents now distinguish research permission from obligation: EASY research is optional, while MEDIUM and HARD retain targeted/deep required research.

The governed publication path now terminates in the release-bound semantic learner publication bundle and bundle-only renderer semantics; LearnerPageBlueprint is explicitly only an internal realization contract where used.
The canonical root now represents approximate/alias discovery as an explicitly non-authoritative candidate layer requiring separate exact-ID selection before Engineering authority.

The root and dual-track specification now describe claim-level pedagogy promotion with decisions, evidence stance, confidence, contradiction handling and promoted generation custody rather than source-list shorthand.
Derived Engineering visibility is now placed after released product authority and before semantic publication, with publication authorization explicitly not implied.

Optional EASY research remains current policy and validator-supported, but both normative documents explicitly state that the canonical SDU/LAU compiler does not yet auto-materialize EASY research bindings.
